climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
building_stock: The Kew records frame smart lock work around detached-house entrances rather than apartments — Rapid Locksmiths' Kew page centres on a deadlock on the front door and a smart lock upgrade, the Airtasker Kew VIC locksmith list carries garage door lock installation alongside smart lock installation, and 24/7 Emergency Locksmith runs a page for a single residential street address (23 Swinton Avenue, Kew) — while the same records also pair Kew houses with commercial premises needing door closers; no returned record says anything about door material, door thickness, heritage timber doors or apartment common-property entrances, so treat door construction as unverified.
demographic_skew: Every demand signal in the Kew records is owner-occupier framed — viclocks.com.au addresses "homeowners across Kew and greater Melbourne" for smart lock installation and rekeying, and the Airtasker Kew VIC lock-installation task shows a resident outsourcing the job rather than self-installing — with no returned record evidencing renters, students, short-stay/Airbnb turnover or any age skew, so write to homeowners deciding on an upgrade and do not lean on rental-provider or Airbnb angles.
common_concerns: Whether the quoted installation price includes the lock hardware or just the labour — the Airtasker Kew VIC lock-installation task poster states the price they set "obviously does not include the cost of the lock", so Kew enquiries arrive unclear on what a smart lock install actually costs all-in.

Which keyless method to commit to — Eastcoast Locksmiths' Kew page presents digital PIN pads, Bluetooth and smart app integration as three separate choices, so residents are choosing between entry methods, not just deciding whether to go keyless.

Whether a smart lock can still be rekeyed or re-matched to existing keys after it is fitted — viclocks.com.au publishes a "Can You Rekey a Smart Lock?" Melbourne guide and names Kew homeowners as the audience for rekeying and upgrades.

Being shut out by the new hardware — Rapid Locksmiths' Kew page lists a smart lock upgrade in the same breath as being called out "because your keys are inside", and the Airtasker Kew VIC locksmith service list opens with 24 hour locksmith services, so lockout risk sits directly next to the upgrade decision in this suburb's search results.
